# Aevium Vanilla

**Aevium Vanilla** is a lightweight client-side modpack that enhances vanilla Minecraft without changing core gameplay.  
It focuses on performance, visuals, and quality-of-life improvements while remaining fully multiplayer-safe.

---

## Performance
- Improved FPS and stability  
- Faster loading and smoother gameplay  
- Optimized for low and high-end systems  
- back-end server saving

![Performance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6211e048f26a57f0a822aade984e79b8cc23e8f.jpeg)

---

## Visuals
- Pre-installed shaders
- Vanilla Tweaks texturepack
- FreshAnimations

![Visuals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7dbaf9ad13caee75daa6cfda59832f81dcae444.jpeg)

---

## Quality of Life
- Mini-map & Worldmap
- Litematica 
- Crop grow highlighter
- Tectonic world generation (Singleplayer only)

![QoL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34579deb72f65f7c40750b7aed01f040f5a59c9c.jpeg)

---

## Beta
**Aevium Vanilla** is currently in beta, with frequent updates and ongoing improvements.
